chunks: When those who believe in Our revelations come to you, say to them: 'Peace on you.' Your Lord has prescribed grace for Himself, so that in case one of you commits evil out of ignorance, then feels repentant and reforms, He may be forgiving and kind.

key_terms.فَإِنَّهُ: then indeed he / so he is

ai.seo_question: What is the condition for God's mercy and forgiveness for those who sin out of ignorance?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for establishing the principle of divine mercy preceding strict judgment, often linked to the concept of 'Al-Rahmah al-Mustahiqqa' (deserved mercy). It underscores that God's forgiveness is not merely a possibility but a self-imposed obligation upon Himself for those who repent from ignorance, reinforcing the balance between justice and compassion in the believer's spiritual journey.
